description: Source code for a tar archive handling module in Git, including functions for writing tar blocks, headers, extended headers, and integrating compression filters.

methods.name: tar_write_block
methods.description: Writes a full block of data to output.

methods.name: write_if_needed
methods.description: Writes the block if it is full.

methods.name: do_write_blocked
methods.description: Queues data writes to ensure full block writes, padding as necessary.

methods.name: finish_record
methods.description: Pads the current record and writes it out.

methods.name: write_blocked
methods.description: Writes data in blocks, ensuring proper padding.

methods.name: write_trailer
methods.description: Marks the end of the tar archive with null bytes.

methods.name: stream_blocked
methods.description: Streams a blob from the repository as a tar object.

methods.name: strbuf_append_ext_header
methods.description: Constructs and appends a pax extended header record.

methods.name: strbuf_append_ext_header_uint
methods.description: Appends a numeric pax extended header record.

methods.name: ustar_header_chksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum for a ustar header.

methods.name: get_path_prefix
methods.description: Gets prefix of a path for tar header.

methods.name: prepare_header
methods.description: Prepares a tar header with file metadata.

methods.name: write_extended_header
methods.description: Writes an extended pax header.

methods.name: write_tar_entry
methods.description: Writes a tar archive entry for a file or directory.

methods.name: write_global_extended_header
methods.description: Writes a global pax extended header.

methods.name: find_tar_filter
methods.description: Finds a tar filter by name.

methods.name: tar_filter_config
methods.description: Configures tar filters based on user settings.

methods.name: git_tar_config
methods.description: Handles git configuration for tar.

methods.name: write_tar_archive
methods.description: Writes the entire tar archive, including headers and trailer.

methods.name: tgz_deflate
methods.description: Performs deflate compression on data.

methods.name: tgz_write_block
methods.description: Writes a block of data through gzip deflation.

methods.name: write_tar_filter_archive
methods.description: Handles writing tar archive with optional compression filter.

methods.name: init_tar_archiver
methods.description: Initializes and registers the tar archiver with optional filters.
